title: Drift Estimation for a Multi-Dimensional Lévy-Driven Stochastic Differential Equation Using Deep Neural Networks
summary: We develop a non-asymptotic theory for nonparametric drift estimation in discretely observed multi-dimensional Lévy-driven stochastic differential equations using sparse ReLU neural networks. Under exponential \(β\)-mixing and an exponential-tail condition on the Lévy measure, we establish an oracle inequality for the least-squares estimator. The jump component changes both the martingale structure and the concentration regime relative to diffusion models: continuous martingales are replaced by discontinuous martingales, while the relevant empirical-process fluctuations are sub-exponential…
